## Naive test before clustering

### Fonctions and parameters

```{r}
library(class)
set.seed(1)

# Parameters

n       <- 100        
q       <- 2           
sigma2  <- 1
sigma   <- sqrt(sigma2)
mu      <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = q)
K       <- 3          
link    <- "average"
B       <- 2000        
n_train <- 60          
k_nn    <- 3           # "three-nearest neighbors classifier"

cols <- c("#006be6", "#b22400", "#1fe1ad")   

# Génération de X

gen_data <- function() {
   matrix(rnorm(n * q, mean = mu , sd = sigma), nrow = n, ncol = q)
}

# Test de Wald

wald_p <- function(x, g1, g2) {
  d     <- sqrt(sum((colMeans(x[g1, , drop = FALSE]) -
                     colMeans(x[g2, , drop = FALSE]))^2))
  scale <- sigma * sqrt(1 / length(g1) + 1 / length(g2))
  pchisq((d / scale)^2, df = q, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

# QQ-plot (density vs uniform density)

qq_unif <- function(p, main) {
  plot(ppoints(length(p)), sort(p), type = "l", lwd = 2,
       xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1),
       xlab = "Theoretical Quantiles", ylab = "Empirical Quantiles",
       main = main)
  abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = "grey40")   # droite y = x : p-values uniformes
}
```

## Figure 1
### a) A simulated dataset from 1


```{r}
# Dataset
x1   <- gen_data()
head(x1)
clust <- cutree(hclust(dist(x1), method = link), k = K)
means1 <- t(sapply(1:K, function(k) colMeans(x1[clust == k, , drop = FALSE])))

plot(x1, col = cols[clust], pch = 19, xlab = "Feature 1", ylab = "Feature 2",
     main = "(a) Data")
points(means1, pch = 17, cex = 2.2, col = "black")


```

## b) QQ-plot distribution vs Wald

```{r}
fig1_run <- function() {
  x   <- gen_data()
  lab <- cutree(hclust(dist(x), method = link), k = K)
  pr  <- sample(K, 2)
  wald_p(x, which(lab == pr[1]), which(lab == pr[2]))
}
p_fig1 <- replicate(B, fig1_run())


qq_unif(p_fig1, "(b) Wald test")
```

## Figure 2 : sample splitting + Wald
### a) Data


```{r}
fig2_draw <- function() {
  repeat {
    x    <- gen_data()
    idx  <- sample(n, n_train)
    xtr  <- x[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    xte  <- x[-idx, , drop = FALSE]
    ltr  <- cutree(hclust(dist(xtr), method = link), k = K)
    lte  <- as.integer(knn(train = xtr, test = xte,
                           cl = factor(ltr, levels = 1:K), k = k_nn))
    if (all(tabulate(lte, nbins = K) >= 1)) break
  }
  list(xtr = xtr, xte = xte, ltr = ltr, lte = lte)
}

# a-c
ex <- fig2_draw()

# d

fig2_run <- function() {
  d  <- fig2_draw()
  pr <- sample(K, 2)
  wald_p(d$xte, which(d$lte == pr[1]), which(d$lte == pr[2]))
}
p_fig2 <- replicate(B, fig2_run())

lim <- range(rbind(ex$xtr, ex$xte))

cl_means <- function(x, lab) {
  t(sapply(1:K, function(k) colMeans(x[lab == k, , drop = FALSE])))
}
means_tr <- cl_means(ex$xtr, ex$ltr)   # clusters du train (estimés sur le train)
means_te <- cl_means(ex$xte, ex$lte)   # clusters du test (assignés par kNN)

# a Data : train+test
plot(ex$xtr, pch = 19, col = "grey60", xlim = lim, ylim = lim,
     xlab = "Feature 1", ylab = "Feature 2", main = "(a) Data")
points(ex$xte, pch = 17, col = "black")
legend("topright", c("training", "test"), pch = c(19, 17),
       col = c("grey60", "black"), bty = "n", cex = 0.8)

# b : clustering Train

plot(ex$xtr, pch = 19, col = cols[ex$ltr], xlim = lim, ylim = lim,
     xlab = "Feature 1", ylab = "Feature 2", main = "(b) Training set")
points(means_tr, pch = 2, cex = 2.4, lwd = 2, col = "black")

#c : tests 
plot(ex$xte, pch = 19, col = cols[ex$lte], cex = 1.2, xlim = lim, ylim = lim,
     xlab = "Feature 1", ylab = "Feature 2", main = "(c) Test set")
points(means_te, pch = 2, cex = 2.4, lwd = 2, col = "black")
legend("topright", bty = "n", cex = 0.8, pch = 19, col = cols,
       legend = paste0("cluster ", 1:K, " (n = ", tabulate(ex$lte, K), ")"))

# d-

qq_unif(p_fig2, "(d) QQ plot")

```


## Taux d'erreur de type I observés (seuil 5 %)

```{r}

cat(sprintf("Fig 1 - Wald, clusters estimés sur toutes les données : %.3f\n",
            mean(p_fig1 < 0.05)))
cat(sprintf("Fig 2 - Wald, sample splitting + kNN                  : %.3f\n",
            mean(p_fig2 < 0.05)))
cat("Attendu pour un test valide : 0.050\n")

```


## Figure 3 

### Parametres et données 
```{r}

set.seed(2026)
col_A <- "#0072B2"   
col_B <- "#E69F00"   
col_C <- "grey55"    
tailles <- c(40, 36, 24)                   # tailles des 3 groupes vrais
q      <- 2
sigma  <- 0.5
K      <- 3
mu_grp <- rbind(c(0.5,  2),      # groupe A 
                c(0.5, -2),      # groupe B : distance A-B = 4
                c(5.0,  0.5))    # groupe C 
grp <- rep(1:3, times = tailles)
mu  <- mu_grp[grp, ]
x   <- matrix(rnorm(length(grp) * q, mean = mu, sd = sigma), ncol = q)
mu
x
plot(x, col = c(col_A, col_B, col_C)[grp], pch = 19, cex = 1,
     xlab = "Feature 1", ylab = "Feature 2", main = "Etape 1 : X = mu + bruit")
points(mu_grp, pch = 4, cex = 2, lwd = 3)
legend("bottomright", bty = "n", pch = c(19, 19, 19, 4), col = c(col_A, col_B, col_C, "black"),
       legend = c("groupe vrai 1", "groupe vrai 2", "groupe vrai 3", "vraie moyenne mu"))

```

### Clustering et choix de C1, C2
```{r}
clust <- cutree(hclust(dist(x), method = "average"), k = K)
table(vrai_groupe = grp, cluster = clust)    

C1 <- which(clust == clust[1])                  # cluster contenant l'obs. 1  (groupe A)
C2 <- which(clust == clust[41])          # cluster contenant l'obs. 41 (groupe B)
clust
C1
C2

pal <- c("#CC79A7", "#009E73", "#56B4E9")
plot(x, col = pal[clust], pch = 19, cex = 1, xlab = "Feature 1", ylab = "Feature 2",
     main = "Etape 2 : clusters et choix de C1, C2")
points(x[c(1, 41), , drop = FALSE], pch = 1, cex = 2, lwd = 2)
text(x[1, 1], x[1, 2], "  obs. 1  ->  C1", pos = 4)
text(x[41, 1], x[41, 2], "  obs. 41  ->  C2", pos = 4)
```

### Equation (14)
```{r}
n1 <- length(C1); n2 <- length(C2)
ecart <- colMeans(x[C1, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(x[C2, , drop = FALSE])
d <- sqrt(sum(ecart^2))                     # ||xbar_C1 - xbar_C2||
u <- ecart / d                              # dir(xbar_C1 - xbar_C2)
cat("d =", round(d, 3), " u =", round(u, 3), "\n")

x_prime <- function(phi) {
  xp <- x
  xp[C1, ] <- t(t(x[C1, , drop = FALSE]) + n2/(n1+n2) * (phi - d) * u)
  xp[C2, ] <- t(t(x[C2, , drop = FALSE]) - n1/(n1+n2) * (phi - d) * u)
  xp
}

cols <- ifelse(seq_len(nrow(x)) %in% C1, col_A, ifelse(seq_len(nrow(x)) %in% C2, col_B, col_C))
xp2 <- x_prime(2 * d)
lim <- range(x, xp2)
plot(x, col = "grey70", pch = 1, cex = 1, xlim = lim, ylim = lim,
     xlab = "Feature 1", ylab = "Feature 2", main = expression("Etape 3 : x'(" * phi * " = 2d)"))
points(xp2, col = cols, pch = 19, cex = 1)
idx <- c(C1, C2)
arrows(x[idx, 1], x[idx, 2], xp2[idx, 1], xp2[idx, 2], length = 0.06, col = cols[idx])
legend("bottomleft", bty = "n", pch = c(1, 19), col = c("grey70", "black"),
       legend = c("donnees d'origine", "donnees deplacees"))

```



#### verifications : x'(d) = x, et la distance entre moyennes vaut phi

```{r}
stopifnot(all.equal(x_prime(d), x))
for (phi in c(0, d, 2 * d)) {
  xp <- x_prime(phi)
  cat("phi =", round(phi, 2), "  : la distance entre moyennes =",
      round(sqrt(sum((colMeans(xp[C1, ]) - colMeans(xp[C2, ]))^2)), 3), "\n")
}
```



### L'algorithme sort-il encore C1 et C2
```{r}
est_cluster <- function(clust, G) {           # G est-il EXACTEMENT un cluster de clust ?
  k <- clust[G[1]]
  all(clust[G] == k) && sum(clust == k) == length(G)
}
dans_S <- function(phi) {
  clust_p <- cutree(hclust(dist(x_prime(phi)), method = "average"), k = K)
  est_cluster(clust_p, C1) && est_cluster(clust_p, C2)
}

dans_S(2)
```




### Les trois panneaux

```{r}
cols <- ifelse(seq_len(nrow(x)) %in% C1, "#0072B2",
        ifelse(seq_len(nrow(x)) %in% C2, "#E69F00", "grey55"))
lim <- range(sapply(c(0, d, 2 * d), function(p) range(x_prime(p))))

panneau <- function(phi, titre) {
  xp <- x_prime(phi)
  plot(xp, col = cols, pch = 19, cex = 1.1, xlim = lim, ylim = lim,
       xlab = "Feature 1", ylab = "Feature 2", main = titre)
  points(rbind(colMeans(xp[C1, ]), colMeans(xp[C2, ])), pch = 2, cex = 2, lwd = 2)
}


par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(4.2, 4.2, 3, 1))
panneau(d,     bquote("(a) Original data (" * phi == .(round(d, 0)) * ")"))
panneau(0,     expression("(b) Perturbed data (" * phi == 0 * ")"))
panneau(8, bquote("(c) Perturbed data (" * phi == .(8) * ")"))
dev.copy(png, "figure3_reproduction.png", width = 2100, height = 700, res = 140)
dev.off()
```
